dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Since memories can be made into books, if we reverse the logic, books can also be written directly into memories...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Hmm... What is it? Is there something you'd like to ask?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Book of Revealing...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Hmm. No matter how I think about this, converting memories into books is quite the incredible deed...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: The creator of this book must've only been able to do this because they viewed the emotions in their memories as the most precious thing in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: That doesn't change how difficult its contents are to parse, though...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got a new page with me...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Ooh, if you've found one or more new pages, just put them inside the book. Let's see what happens!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not really.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Alright... Oh, yes. If you ever feel sad, come over here — let's meditate together. Maybe that'll help cheer you up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the earthquake just a while ago...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Earthquake? Oh, you mean that bit a moment ago where everything was swaying? Well, I was thinking about other things, so I didn't pay much attention...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Book of Revealing...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #...So scary! Terrifying! If it wasn't for {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, I don't know what would've happened to me.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: But why? Why would monsters appear in such a beautiful place? Is it really that...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Nope! Not gonna keep thinking about that. It wasn't easy for me to forge a life for myself here.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: If you find another page, or want to meditate... The book hasn't moved. But please, be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Thank you. If it wasn't for you, I might never have made it back.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Merusea Village is beautiful, and everyone is really nice. I should treasure life here a little more, and the "world" around me.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Perhaps, the world of "meditation" is not as wonderful as I once thought?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Yes. Thank you.
